title: Tunisian-Style Prawns with Zesty Marinade
description: A flavorful and refreshing dish inspired by Tunisian cuisine, featuring succulent prawns marinated in a zesty mixture.
instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine zesty marinade ingredients: lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and a pinch of salt.
3. Place prawns in a large bowl and pour the marinade over them.
5. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
6. Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
7. Remove prawns from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
8. Grill prawns for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they turn pink and are cooked through.
9. Garnish with parsley and serve immediately.
10. Serve with couscous or rice, if desired.
